Metadata.summary: Cruz Manuelos, a rough-around-the-edges but passionate young Marine, is recruited to join the CIA's Lioness Engagement Team to help bring down a terrorist organization from within. Joe, the station chief of the Lioness program, is tasked with training, managing and leading her female undercover operatives.
Metadata.title: Lioness

CommonSenseMedia.oneLiner: Gritty military action series has stereotypes, violence.
